name: Sticks and Bones
summary: Deathguard Bartholomew asks travelers in Tirisfal Glades to gather dry branches for Eleanor Shackleton. The experienced survivalist camps in the western hills, far from the settlements.

sections.title: A Friendly Gesture
sections.body: Deathguard Bartholomew pauses between patrols to help an acquaintance in Tirisfal Glades. Deathguards guard against the Scourge and Scarlet crusaders, but Bartholomew also looks out for Eleanor Shackleton. She spends her unlife in the harsh elements, so he asks you to gather dry branches for her campfire.

sections.title: Life in the Wilds
sections.body: Eleanor Shackleton survives alone in Tirisfal's blighted wilderness. Though undead, the Forsaken still feel the damp, bitter chill rolling off the northern moors. Eleanor's rule for gathering wood is simple: when you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more. Grateful for the extra timber, she lets you keep Bartholomew's basket and shares the warmth of her fire.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Sticks and Bones?
faq.answer: Deathguard Bartholomew in Tirisfal Glades asks passing travelers to help his associate Eleanor Shackleton.

aliases: where to turn in sticks and bones
faq.answer: Eleanor Shackleton keeps a small camp in the hills west of Tirisfal Glades, where she survives the elements away from the settlements.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken need firewood if they are undead?
faq.answer: The Forsaken do not freeze to death like the living, but they still feel Tirisfal's damp, bitter cold. A campfire comforts them, warms their stiff joints, and helps keep a camp livable in the wilds.

faq.q: What advice does Eleanor give about gathering wood?
faq.answer: Eleanor's rule is to gather five times more firewood than you think you need.

faq.q: What item do you use to collect the branches?
faq.answer: Deathguard Bartholomew gives you a basket for carrying the six dry branches found across the glades. Eleanor lets you keep it after the delivery.

faq.q: Does this quest lead to further survival training?
faq.answer: Eleanor welcomes you to her camp and shares advice for traveling the wilds. She also offers a friendly contact point in the Tirisfal wilderness.

angles.text: Even in Lordaeron's blighted woods, Forsaken travelers like Eleanor Shackleton must adapt old survival habits to their new unlife.
Outlying campers like Eleanor offer friendly stopping points for young Horde adventurers setting out across Tirisfal Glades.
